home.hero_subtitle_1: Free access to structured robotics and engineering education
home.hero_subtitle_3: Built on FIRST values and goals to develop
home.about_body: Tagylym is an open online platform giving students and mentors from all regions of Kazakhstan free access to structured courses in robotics, programming and engineering. All tracks are built on FIRST values and criteria, not just to teach robot building, but to help teams grow into strong participants, mentors, and future engineers.
home.about_quote: Hundreds of schools with robotics equipment don't use it to its full potential due to lack of content and mentors.
home.problem_body: Today, access to quality STEM education and robotics depends heavily on city, school, and family income: major centers have specialized Lyceums and clubs, while rural schools, even when they have robotics classrooms, often lack content, methodologies, and mentors. As a result, thousands of children interested in technology cannot receive structured education, don't learn about FIRST, and lose the opportunity to start their engineering career.
home.problem_quote: Over 60% of Kazakhstan's students study in rural schools and small towns where access to sustainable STEM programs is limited.

fll.core_values_body: Team values make up 25% of the Champion Award points. Teamwork, inclusivity, and engaging learning are an essential part of the competition.
fll.core_values_text: Core values are not a separate subject. They are integrated into the entire learning process. During evaluations, judges look at how the team demonstrates these values during competitions.
